judgments.en_span: "Consideration" means the consideration payable by the Company for the Sale Shares under the Agreement
judgments.zh_span: 「代價」指本公司根據本協議就銷售股份應付的代價
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Consideration identically using glossary terms.

judgments.en_span: "Director(s)" means the director(s) of the Company
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Director(s) identically using glossary terms.

judgments.en_span: "EGM" means the extraordinary general meeting of the Company to be convened and held to consider and, if thought fit, approve the Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereunder
judgments.zh_span: 「股東特別大會」指本公司將召開及舉行以考慮及酌情批准本協議及其項下擬進行的交易的股東特別大會
judgments.explanation: Both versions define EGM identically with equivalent conditional language (if thought fit / 酌情).

judgments.en_span: "Group" means the Company and its subsidiaries
judgments.zh_span: 「本集團」指本公司及其附屬公司
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Group identically using glossary terms.

judgments.en_span: "HK$" means Hong Kong dollars, the lawful currency of Hong Kong
judgments.explanation: Both versions define HK$ identically as Hong Kong's lawful currency.

judgments.en_span: "Hong Kong" means the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the PRC
judgments.zh_span: 「香港」指中國香港特別行政區
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Hong Kong identically using glossary terms.

judgments.en_span: "Independent Board Committee" means the independent committee of the Board comprising all the independent non-executive Directors, established to advise the Independent Shareholders in respect of the Agreement and the Acquisition
judgments.zh_span: 「獨立董事委員會」指由全體獨立非執行董事組成，以就本協議及收購事項向獨立股東提供意見的董事會獨立委員會
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Independent Board Committee identically using glossary terms.

judgments.en_span: "Independent Financial Adviser" means Crestview Capital Limited, a corporation licensed to carry out Type 1 (dealing in securities) and Type 6 (advising on corporate finance) regulated activities under the SFO, being the independent financial adviser appointed to advise the Independent Board Committee and the Independent Shareholders
judgments.zh_span: 「獨立財務顧問」指峰景資本有限公司，一間根據證券及期貨條例可進行第1類（證券交易）及第6類（就機構融資提供意見）受規管活動的持牌法團，為獲委任以向獨立董事委員會及獨立股東提供意見的獨立財務顧問
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Independent Financial Adviser identically with same company name and regulatory details.

judgments.en_span: "Independent Shareholders" means Shareholders other than the Vendor, Mr. Chan Wai Kwong and their respective associates
judgments.zh_span: 「獨立股東」指除賣方、陳偉光先生及彼等各自的聯繫人以外的股東
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Independent Shareholders identically using glossary terms.

judgments.en_span: "Independent Third Party(ies)" means person(s) or company(ies) which, to the best of the Directors' knowledge, information and belief, having made all reasonable enquiries, are independent of and not connected with the Company and its connected persons
judgments.zh_span: 「獨立第三方」指據董事經作出一切合理查詢後所深知、盡悉及確信，獨立於本公司及其關連人士且與彼等概無關連的人士或公司
judgments.explanation: Both versions define Independent Third Party(ies) identically with equivalent knowledge qualifications.
